descriptor.retrieval_description: Metal cylindrical beverage can with a smooth, dry, coated exterior surface and continuous curvature. The intended contact region has no visible seams or contamination within the lateral grasp band.
descriptor.contact_region: The lateral sidewalls of the cylindrical can, located at the centered grasp band between the opposing fingers.
descriptor.contact_material: Coated metal substrate forming the exterior surface of the beverage can.
descriptor.local_geometry: Continuous cylindrical curvature with smooth lateral surface.
descriptor.contact_patch_visibility: The top-down perspective clearly shows the circular profile and upper rim, but the specific lateral contact patches along the vertical sidewalls are partially occluded by the overhead view.
descriptor.uncertainty: The exact surface texture and condition of the lower lateral sidewalls cannot be fully detailed due to the top-down perspective, though the overall cylindrical shape and metal material are clearly discernible.
